name: The Smoosh
description: Two smashed beef patties, melted American cheese, grilled onions, pickles, and Smoosh sauce on a toasted bun.

name: The Double Smoosh
description: A bigger version of the original Smoosh with extra smashed beef, extra cheese, grilled onions, pickles, and Smoosh sauce.
